message: サリーちゃんの逆襲

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, this is the Ryuusei Student Council. Amakawa Dairy, thank you as always for your business. Milk, you say? You'll need electrical wiring for a refrigerator, understood.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san. They say they'd like to know how the delivery route is set up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's the vendors handling each booth, hand trucks are fine. If they don't have enough, we'll go help.」

name: Synn
message: 「This shop goes in this section, and this shop uses open flames, so it goes over here...」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, have some tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. Thank you very much. *Sip*... Haa, delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then, just one more push, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Let's push through and finish it up--is what I'd like to say, however...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「President! I really don't think this is a workload we can finish today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm... Yeah, that's true.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if we should do some work tomorrow as well.」

name: Ria
message: 「No can do~\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You say that, Senpai-san, but time passes far too quickly in the Human World! We simply lack the time!」

name: Ria
message: 「Getting proper rest is part of the job too. If you push yourself too hard and collapse, who's going to take your place?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ask Sacchin... nah, impossible.」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai is right. We have no choice but to do everything we possibly can today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's give it our all until the time limit.」

name: Helena
message: 「Good work, everyone. They're going to lock the school gates soon, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A time bomb without a fuse!」
They all slump their heads in defeat at once, yet not a single one of them makes a move to pack up their things.

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, head home already. It'll be a huge problem if the Student Council officers get caught by security.」

name: Helena
message: 「You can still do Student Council activities even if you're not in the Student Council room, can't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh?」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, if you're taking tomorrow off anyway, pushing yourself for just one night wouldn't hurt, right? The night is still young, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. You're right! Then--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, I know just the place. Right, boss!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Ah! Yeah! That's right, yeah」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, too bad. You beat me to it」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's good you didn't say it. Because I definitely think that place is the absolute best」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Let's all head over to my place right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A-A-A sleepover--hiiih!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your voice is cracking--what are you getting all chicken about now」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's bad. Having girls stay overnight and all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Making them go home late at night is way more dangerous!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But boys and girls our age under the same roof!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph. Even though you never say a word when I stay over\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, my heart is pounding...\s03 I have to make sure nobody notices how I'm feeling」

name: Misa
message: 「Fidgeting around like that is creepy」
I couldn't take it anymore.

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing, I just felt a chill」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, zip up your front and keep warm」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thanks」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Haa... haa... sorry to keep you waiting~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san, and even Senpai. You're both in an awfully good mood」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because it's a sleepover, a sleepover!! It's her very first time staying overnight anywhere other than her own home」

name: Synn
message: 「Hoho~. Just as expected of a young lady」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-th-that's right! Got it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even today, she was only granted special permission because her butler is accompanying her」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please, by all means――」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Take good care of the young lady」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes, sir」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me, then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. He wandered off somewhere. Is it really okay for her bodyguard to leave?」

name: Ria
message: 「He's just being considerate, I'm sure」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And what about the other young lady――」

name: Misa
message: 「C-could you mean me……?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you going to be okay, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course, I am the oldest sister, after all. I've gotta be a pro~per guardian for everyone♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Just as expected of you, big sister……」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」
Ria-senpai puffs out her chest proudly. Is it just my imagination, or does the guardian look more excited than anyone else?

name: Helena
message: 「If you try anything perverted with my Ria, I won't forgive you」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! I'm not a kid anymore, you know!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm worried precisely because you're not a kid anymore~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It'll be fine, I tell you. After all, I'm right here with her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Am I really that untrustworthy?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't they say that boys are beasts in human skin?」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, though I doubt Sakura-kun has that kind of nerve」

name: Synn
message: 「M-M-M... I-I can do it too... when it counts!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not what you should be trying to prove!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, this is no time to be playing around. Let's hurry up and finish our shopping」

name: Synn
message: 「Around this time of day, they have flash sales, so it's a great deal」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh-ho~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah. Is this that age where even a falling chopstick makes them giggle?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san. Haven't you started sounding a bit like Lolotte-san?」
Hm? Something's noisy over there.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, perfect timing, Student Council」

name: Synn
message: 「Auntie Shinagawa. Are you closing up shop for the day already?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Listen to this. Apparently, a dine-and-dash incident is about to go down at the gyudon place. A clear and present danger, right here and now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha, seriously!? We gotta go check it out!!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hey, Nanaka-chan! I won't let you leave me behind and get a head start!」

name: Synn
message: 「Those two are as nosy as ever~」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, hush, you. Call me a seeker of truth」
Auntie Shinagawa ran off after Nanaka as well.

name: Misa
message: 「Gyudon, dine-and-dash... Something about that rings a bell」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like we recently met someone who said those exact words quite often」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat gyudon!!」

name: Ria
message: 「If I recall, the one saying that was Sally-chan, wasn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!! No, no way. Sally-chan wouldn't dine and dash anymore」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But I think the connection is way too strong」

name: Synn
message: 「She eats delicious curry at my house every single day, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Curry!?」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's curry, she ought to be completely satisfied」

name: Synn
message: 「Why's that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Because it's delicious--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, what are you making me say!\s03」

name: Paqy
message: 「She definitely got tired of that curry and gave in to a moment of weakness.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I believe in Sally... or rather, I want to believe in her」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Otherwise, all that curry you fed her was a total waste.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't think everything's gonna go the way you want!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wanna eat curry~」

name: Misa
message: 「Me too--wait, this isn't the time for that, is it!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway, we can't just leave her alone. Let's go, everyone.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, Prez!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally...」
A shock hits me on par with being tricked into thinking tobiko was salmon roe.

name: Sally
message: 「I was hungry, so I figured I'd go do the grocery shopping for you, y'know~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... *shiver, shiver*」

name: Sally
message: 「But I didn't have any money!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sally
message: 「Still, you'll give me credit for the thought of trying to go shopping, right?! So hurry up and make some yummy food today too, pleeeeease!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... so that's what happened...」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu~ Today's work is officially all done~~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaaaah...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a relief, Synn-kun\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「If you believed in me, you wouldn't be looking so relieved, would you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are a worrywart, President」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, if that's the case, I wonder who the culprit is」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn-Synn-Shiiin! Big trouble, huuuge trouble!!」
Heading over to the beef bowl shop with Sally―chan in tow, what awaited us there\nwas―.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This is...」
Just from one look.
He was impossibly, unmistakably oozing with demon aura!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you! What's the big idea wining and dining when you ain't even got any money!!」
Not flinching in the slightest against someone like that--truly befitting the shopping district's idol.

name: Demon
message: 「Me, still, hungry. Extra-large, feed me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can't you see the manager's in a bind here!? Hurry up and let yourself get tied up already!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, what's going on here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, this big lug went and ordered a beef bowl, only to have no wallet and no cash, so it's a total mess」

name: Demon
message: 「Extra-large, feed me more」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And yet he's acting all high and mighty like this. Don't you dare look down on us just 'cause we're in the service industry!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Honestly, I think he was way too suspicious the moment he walked into the shop...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can't judge a book by its cover, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. That doesn't work as a defense」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!? Boss!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Boss!! Why are you eating a beef bowl?!\s09」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, give him a piece of your mind!」

name: Sally
message: 「Not fair, not fair, not fair!! I wanna eaaaat too!!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is hopeless...」

name: Boss / Oyabin
message: 「Student Council, beat up」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh?」

name: Boss / Oyabin
message: 「Payback, counterattack, beat up」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, ahhhhh~~~~!! That's right, I totally forgot!! You're right, Boss. These guys are that rotten Student Council!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!? After how friendly we were just getting!?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's that, and this is this! Time to settle the score from back then!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so comes the betrayal~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Tsk, tsk, tsk. Watch how you phrase things, Roro-chi. I'm grateful you treated me to a meal, sure, but that's a completely separate matter!」

name: Ria
message: 「Easy, easy--just calm down first, Sally-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Oops, my bad. Anyway, hurry up, Boss!」

name: Boss / Oyabin
message: 「Wait. Beef bowl, eat」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, Boss, you can't eat that! We don't have any money~. Jeez, forget about food, we've gotta beat up the Student Council!!」

name: Misa
message: 「She understood what I said, yet she's still completely raring for a fight...\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph, scared stiff, huh? Listen up--Boss is so strong, people call her one of the Seven Demon Generals~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Seven lemon genitals?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sev... One of the Seven Demon Generals...!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Senpai, you know what that is?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah. I've heard about them from my big sister. Rumor has it they're demons whose power is second only to the Demon King's...」

name: Misa
message: 「T-The Demon King!?

name: Misa
message: If they're the ruler of all demons... they must possess... incredible power...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, I see! If she's only second to the Demon King, we'll be fine--right, Lord Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Flinch*」
However, he looks even stronger than any Demon we've faced so far... and by extension, stronger than Sally-chan, too.
More than anything, he's huge. So HUGE that it makes me straighten my back and put on a brave front. What an overwhelming presence!
In terms of mammals, he's like a whale. Canned ones aren't half bad, either.

name: Sally
message: 「Of course, I'm gonna fight too\s07」
I-I've got a feeling this is gonna be a tough opponent...!
